rule: R-COL-CORE-DATUM-1 (proposed): a column's foundation core starts at the footing top; footing top = formation + printed underlay + H; with the formation printed only as a limit the core has a LOWER bound (formation at the limit) and an OPEN upper bound; underlay not printed for the support -> HELD; never measured from the formation, never a ledger convention called a bound

t273_finding_reconciled.note: T-273 r2 applied the p.13 0.17 m underlay to all 31 chains with a known footing. Withdrawn here: the 4 lift chains on FF (p.14 prints the membrane with no thickness: FF underlay HELD, T-206 r2; footing top = pit floor, pit depth HELD, D-43) and the 3 CN columns on p.13 footings that stop in the foundation storey (top datum = closing member top, not printed). Added: the 2 F / F10 conflict chains it left out, restated on max H (valid for both readings).
t273_finding_reconciled.rounding_cause: T-273 r2 took kg/m from the ledger's row kg (rounded to 3 decimals) / total length; here kg/m = pi/4 d^2 x 7850 unrounded (the ledger's own method)
